display_name: List one worker's Claude-session mapping history
description: usage-capture-attribution D2 follow-on (2026-08-06). Lists every live session_claude_mapping row observed for one agent_instance_id -- the SessionStart-hook-captured (or headless init-event) record of which Claude Code claude_session_id(s) this worker has fired under over its whole lifetime, ONE-TO-MANY because a /clear or /resume rotates the Claude session UUID without touching the managed_session row. Each row carries agent_instance_id, claude_session_id, captured_at (the hook payload's own timestamp), and capture_source (hook:startup | hook:clear | hook:resume | init_event), plus the standard state-layer row fields every table carries (id, namespace, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, name, is_deleted, external_id). Read-only, issues no writes -- a thin wrapper over the same store-layer function budget_report's usage join already uses internally. An empty list means no mapping has EVER been observed for this worker, not an error -- that is itself diagnostic (the SessionStart hook never fired, or the worker predates the capture landing).
embedding_description: List a worker's raw SessionStart-hook mapping rows by agent_instance_id -- which Claude Code session_id(s) it fired under, when, and via which capture path. Distinct from budget_report (aggregates this table, never exposes raw rows) and session_status (a different table, the lifecycle row) -- the diagnostic read a budget_report investigation needs when a session is unexpectedly uncovered.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: mappings: an array of every live session_claude_mapping row for the given agent_instance_id. Each entry: agent_instance_id, claude_session_id, captured_at (ISO-8601), capture_source (hook:startup | hook:clear | hook:resume | init_event), plus the standard row fields (id, namespace, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, name, is_deleted, external_id). Order is not guaranteed -- sort by captured_at if chronological order matters.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with the count of rows and the distinct claude_session_id values -- that is the ONE-TO-MANY rotation history in one glance. An empty array is a legitimate, common answer (hook never fired for this worker, or it predates the capture landing) -- say so plainly rather than treating it as a failed lookup.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: A single filtered read on agent_instance_id against the session_claude_mapping table (is_deleted=0). No writes, no host interaction.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: missing_agent_instance_id: the caller passed an empty agent_instance_id. state_service_unavailable: the state service is not bound on this solet.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For missing_agent_instance_id, supply a real agent_instance_id (from list_sessions or a spawn_session result) rather than retrying with an empty value. state_service_unavailable indicates a platform binding problem, not a caller error.
